ios.desc:
CoderLife is a minimalist startup survival game where every decision matters.

You are a solo developer trying to build a startup before money, time, or energy runs out.

Code your product, take freelance work to pay rent, pitch investors, and fight burnout — all under constant pressure.

FEATURES

• 3 difficulty modes: Easy, Medium, Hard
• Realistic startup struggles: money, energy, progress
• Random events that can save or destroy your run
• Terminal-style system log UI
• Short but intense play sessions
• No ads. No IAP. Build your app.

Can you ship before everything collapses?

quotes.text:
I wanted to see how fast I could ship a complete product and whether a minimal coding simulation game would resonate.

Built in 5 days, text-based, no ads, no tracking.

App Store Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/coderlife-startup-simulator/id6757819343
